confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; July hotel and hostel rates are the least certain because Florence high-season pricing varies widely. Cocktail and wine anchors are based on the local beer-to-drink relationship. The FX observation was taken from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other high-demand Italian heritage cities such as Venice, Rome and Siena, adjusted for Florence's strong summer tourism premium on accommodation and central-restaurant pricing.
